document.about: The General Data Protection Regulation, (EU) 2016/679, as the Publications Office serves it in XHTML: 11 chapters, their sections and 99 articles, with no h1 to h6 anywhere.

notes: Once read as 1,821 paragraphs and no section. The Official Journal's XHTML declares no headings: its outline is in classes and identifiers of its own. Headings are read by their shape, a keyword and a number in a paragraph of their own with the title in the paragraph after it, and nested by how often each keyword occurs.

checks.issue: Article 30 was a paragraph, with no section holding it.
As above, for the section above it.
Chapter I has no sections; its articles are its own, at the level articles take elsewhere.
A guard: a line in capitals is not a heading for that alone.
